hero.intro: Restaurant, lounge bar, pastry counter and ice-cream parlour in the centre of Brazzaville. A garden terrace under a pergola by day, a soft-lit lounge by night, and house-made cakes at any hour.
hero.kicker: Restaurant, lounge bar, pastry & ice cream in the heart of Brazzaville
hero.sub: A house that opens onto a garden, from the first coffee of the morning to the last cocktail of the night.

intro.heading: One address, four ways to meet
intro.text: Coffee and a croissant at the counter in the morning. Lunch in the shade of the pergola. A slice of cake in the afternoon. A cocktail at the lounge bar at night. L'Assiette brings all of it together under one roof on Avenue des Aiglons.

facets.title: Restaurant
facets.text: Generous cooking, from sharing bruschetta to flambéed king prawns, served indoors or in the garden.

facets.title: Lounge bar
facets.text: Velvet stools, low light and cocktails mixed at the bar until 11:30 pm.

facets.title: Pastry
facets.text: Entremets, tarts and celebration cakes made on site, to take away or to order.

facets.title: Ice cream
facets.text: Ice creams and sorbets in daily flavours, chosen straight from the display.

featured.heading: Signature plates
featured.text: A few dishes our guests photograph before they taste.

items.title: In the heart of Brazzaville
items.text: Avenue des Aiglons, opposite Royal Spice and next to the Olympic Palace: easy to find, easy to love.

items.title: Open 7:30 am to 11:30 pm
items.text: Seven days a week, from breakfast to the last drink. No need to watch the clock.

items.title: A garden terrace
items.text: Lawn, pergola, plants and turquoise armchairs: one of the most pleasant outdoor spaces in the city centre.

items.title: Your celebrations, our cakes
items.text: Birthdays, weddings, themed nights: we make the cakes and host your events.

atmosphere.heading: From the first coffee to the last drink

night.title: By night
night.text: The lounge bar takes over: coloured lamps, banquettes, music and cocktails. DJ nights and themed buffets set the calendar.

about.heading: Flavours of life
about.lead: L'Assiette grew from a simple idea: to gather, in one place in central Brazzaville, everything that makes a day a little sweeter.

story.title: The address
story.text: On Avenue des Aiglons, steps from Avenue de l'Amitié, L'Assiette occupies a house that opens onto a garden. People come in for a coffee, stay for lunch and come back in the evening. Over the months the pastry counter earned its display case, the lounge bar its velvet stools, and the terrace its turquoise armchairs.

philosophy.title: The philosophy
philosophy.text: Keep it simple and do it well. Fresh produce, generous plates, pastry worked every morning and service that takes its time. The name says it: everything starts on the plate.

cuisine.title: The food and the table
cuisine.text: The menu travels without losing its way: bruschetta and salads to share, grilled king prawns and salmon, baked pasta, generous burgers, then the dessert display. At the bar, cocktails are mixed to order, with or without alcohol.

place.title: The place
place.text: Two moods live side by side. By day, the garden terrace under its pergola, with lawn and plants. By night, the indoor lounge: banquettes, hanging coloured lamps, marble tables and music. Both host your birthdays, business dinners and private parties.

day.title: By day
day.heading: Garden light
day.text: At 7:30 the display fills with tarts and entremets, coffee is poured, and the pergola filters the sun onto the lawn. Lunch happens outside, in the shade of the plants, feet almost in the grass.
